summary: Brookfield Infrastructure Partners L.P. and Brookfield Infrastructure Corporation filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated November 6, 2026 reporting third-quarter 2026 results for the period ended September 30, 2026. FFO was $717 million, or $0.91 per unit, a 10% year-over-year increase and the third consecutive quarter at the growth target; net income was $69 million versus $440 million prior year, reflecting lower asset-sale gains. Management cited an expanding investment pipeline. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics were disclosed; this is a routine earnings report, not a special situation.
